run_eval_bot: run a Hanabi bot evaluation simulation with a specified bot name and number of games
run_eval_bot_with_seed: run a Hanabi bot evaluation with a fixed random seed for reproducible results
run_eval_bot_multiplayer: run a Hanabi bot evaluation simulation with a custom number of players
run_eval_bot_logging: run a Hanabi bot evaluation that logs progress every N games
run_eval_bot_default: run a Hanabi bot evaluation using the default SmartBot with 1000 games
